depiction.primary_object: two stacked horizontal rectangles each with a circle on the left
depiction.composition: two stacked rack units, front view

readings.meaning: NAS / hard drive storage / data backup

ambiguity: Can look like two toggle switches in the off position, a chest of drawers with offset handles, or two bulleted list cards.
task_intents: maintain or upgrade a home server
set up NAS storage or backups
renew web hosting or VPS plan
replace hard drives in storage array
configure self-hosted media or cloud server
audit cloud infrastructure and server costs

example_tasks.task: Move staging server from DigitalOcean to a cheaper Hetzner box
Set up automated offsite backup from the NAS to Backblaze B2
Swap the failing 4TB WD Red in bay 2 before the rebuild starts
Order two 8TB IronWolf drives while the Black Friday deal is live
Spin up a small Valheim dedicated server for Friday night with the guys
Upgrade Ubuntu LTS on the production app servers during the Sunday maintenance window
Compare annual vs monthly billing Before Friday
Document all static IP assignments and ports
Replace noisy 40mm stock fans in the 1U rack chassis with Noctua ones before summer hits
Consolidate the three old Raspberry Pis onto one low-power mini PC running Proxmox in the closet
Test restoring a full snapshot from the backup server onto a spare VM to verify disaster recovery

example_tasks_es: Renovar el VPS de OVH antes de que cobren la tarifa nueva
Cambiar el disco duro dañado de la bahía 1 en el NAS de casa
Actualizar Proxmox y reiniciar los contenedores del servidor doméstico
example_tasks_ru: Оплатить хостинг и VPS на полгода вперёд
Настроить еженедельный бэкап фотоархива на домашний NAS
Продуть от пыли домашний сервер в кладовке и проверить диски

context_tasks.task: Rotate SSH keys across all production machines
Fix Let's Encrypt SSL certificate auto-renewal cronjob
Install Jellyfin for the living room TV
Crimping shorter Cat6 patch cables for the patch panel

near_misses.task: Tip the server nicely at the anniversary dinner
Practice flat first serve down the T before Saturday's match

Fix sticking top drawer on the bedroom dresser

reasoning: Shows two stacked rack-mount units with indicator lights/buttons on the left, the standard glyph for a server, NAS, or hosting infrastructure. It fits IT, web hosting, data backup, and homelab tasks well, though at small sizes it can resemble stacked toggle switches or drawers.
